proof_body:
by
  intro f g h U c hU hc hg hh eg eh
  have hint : ∀ z ∈ U, ∃ n : ℤ, (g z - h z) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) = n := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : Complex.exp (g z) = Complex.exp (h z) := (eg z hz).trans (eh z hz).symm
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp h1
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [hn]
    have := Complex.two_pi_I_ne_zero
    field_simp
    ring
  set φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (g z - h z) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) with hφ
  have hφc : ContinuousOn φ U := (hg.sub hh).div_const _
  have hdisc : DiscreteTopology (Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℂ)) := by
    refine DiscreteTopology.of_forall_le_dist (r := 1) one_pos ?_
    rintro ⟨_, m, rfl⟩ ⟨_, n, rfl⟩ hne
    have hmn : m ≠ n := fun e => hne (by simp [e])
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ) - n| := by
      have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m - n| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.mpr hmn)
      exact_mod_cast h1
    simpa [Subtype.dist_eq, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_intCast, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real] using this
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo φ U (Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℂ)) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hint z hz
    exact ⟨n, hn.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hint c hc
  refine ⟨k, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have heq : φ z = φ c := hU.constant_of_mapsTo (isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr hdisc) hφc hmaps hz hc
  have h2 := Complex.two_pi_I_ne_zero
  have : (g z - h z) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) = k := heq.trans hk
  rw [div_eq_iff h2] at this
  exact this
target_source: ∀ (f g h : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → ContinuousOn g U → ContinuousOn h U → (∀ z ∈ U, Complex.exp (g z) = f z) → (∀ z ∈ U, Complex.exp (h z) = f z) → ∃ k : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ U, g z - h z = k * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)
